segments.title: Pandas eat SO much bamboo!
segments.say: {zh:你好!} That means hello! I'm Mei from China. Let's meet the panda!

segments.title: Up to 100 pounds a day!
segments.say: Pandas eat up to one hundred pounds of bamboo a day!

segments.title: A secret thumb!
segments.say: A special wrist bone works like a thumb!

segments.title: How big is a baby panda?
segments.say: How big is a baby panda? A cat, a butter stick, or a puppy? Three. Two. One.

segments.title: A stick of butter!
segments.say: A stick of butter! So tiny.

segments.title: COMMENT BELOW
segments.tiny: A new kid, a new animal
